settings.title: Activity

share.label: Share my activity
share.description: Shows on your profile the game or app you are using, like "Playing Minecraft". It works in the Overcord desktop app, which recognizes games and apps from a known list and, while Discord is closed, the details games send through Discord Rich Presence.

shown.label: Activity shown
shown.description: With more than one game or app open, choose which one to show. On automatic, the game in front wins, then a game sending Rich Presence, then the game Steam is running, then other games and apps.

settings.gamesDescription: A hidden game or app is never shown to others, even with sharing on.
settings.detectedEmpty: No game or app detected yet. Open one while Overcord is running and it shows up here.
settings.activeEmpty: Every game and app detected is hidden. Show one again from the Hidden tab.
settings.hiddenEmpty: Nothing hidden. A game or app you hide goes here.
settings.desktopOnly: Detection happens in the Overcord desktop app. In the browser you only choose whether to share.

errors.offline: No connection to the server. Try again in a moment.
